title: Archive is a bare top-level button on the session page and runs on one click, no confirmation
what_happens: The 'Archive session' card sits in the page body with a plain 'Archive' button. Reading archive-toggle.tsx, one click sends the PATCH straight away: no '…' menu, no confirm step. (Not clicked: production.)
who_hurts: Dane or an organizer scrolling this long page between 'Save changes' and the Voices section can archive a live session by mistake; it drops off the landing page and stops taking answers mid-conversation.
suggested_fix: Move Archive / Un-archive into a '…' actions menu in the page header (next to Copy join link) with a confirm dialog naming the session and its voice count. Keep the explanatory text inside the confirm. src/app/admin/sessions/[code]/archive-toggle.tsx, page.tsx:203.
rule: Dane's UI rule: "Never put a Delete button (or any other destructive action: remove, archive, cancel, void) at the top level of a row, card or page header. It always goes inside a '…' actions menu, with a confirmation before it runs."
